title: Where are my cookies?
subtitle: The least delicious browser feature.
takeaway: Cookies store small bits of browser data. Review your choices.

boards.heading: A small browser memory
boards.note: A site can remember a setting or session.

boards.heading: Different purposes
boards.note: Some cookies support tracking. Review the options.

turns.speaker: student
turns.text: I accepted cookies on twelve websites. Still no snacks.

turns.speaker: tutor
turns.text: Browser cookies. Small bits of stored information.

turns.speaker: student
turns.text: So I have been feeding my browser?

turns.speaker: tutor
turns.text: Think of a tiny note. A website can remember a setting or your session.

turns.speaker: student
turns.text: Like: this person is always hungry?

turns.speaker: tutor
turns.text: More like your language preference. Some cookies also help track activity.

turns.speaker: student
turns.text: So I should actually read the choices?

turns.speaker: tutor
turns.text: Yes. Cookies have different jobs. They are not all the same.

turns.speaker: tutor
turns.text: That button is not on the website.
